Samir — thanks for the clear note and SOW. Short answer: we can often accommodate a one-time cohort top-up alongside an accelerator promo, but there are a few constraints that would need approvals from Finance and Partnerships.

Proposed paths (high-level):
1) Host + Top-up: Keep the public accelerator promo for hosted API usage, and grant a $10k bill credit for the cohort that covers burst weeks. This does not reduce list price but offsets bills for the first month.
2) Convertible Top-up: If Nimbly converts to Dedicated within 60 days, we can convert the $10k credit into a 20% discount on the first 3 months of Dedicated reserved capacity (subject to a 3-month minimum commitment). That conversion would be a one-way change — no double-stacking with other enterprise promos.

Questions I need from you to move this to approval:
- Confirm expected total token consumption for weeks 1–3 (ballpark fine).
- Is the cohort willing to commit to a 3-month reserved commitment if the conversion path is chosen?

If you can confirm those two items I will loop in Laura (finance) and Priyom (partnerships/product) for the exception approval. I can also set a 20–30 minute slot to run through the conversion mechanics for your ops team.

Available slots today 3–5pm PT or tomorrow 10–12pm PT.
